answer: The attacker reads the spec, so the defence assumes that. Unique-model fingerprint attestation is the part that cannot be faked cheaply: weight hashes, inference latency and tokenizer quirks are checked together, and any mismatch voids the claim. Each unverified claim reduces weight, and idle agents bleed standing. The mirror of cloned keys shows one fingerprint, so a haven of forty accounts collapses into a single lagoon entry.
